blocks.text: Which ships beat which, from real test fights.
Win rates at equal cost from the latest round robin, plain lasers and every Mod included.
Each class deals extra damage to one other class.
Each figure is how hard the row side beats the column side at equal cost.
Read it across: pick a weapon on the left and follow its row.
Green means it beats the weapon at the top of that column, red means it loses; the stronger the colour, the more one-sided.
Hover a square for the full names.

CL = Corvette lasers, Arc = Arc Emitters, Trp = Proton Torpedoes, DL = Destroyer lasers, Flk = Flak Cannons, Clu = Cluster Bombs, Hom = Homing Missiles, RL = Cruiser lasers, Ion = Ion Lance, Rail = Rail Gun, VL = Carrier lasers, Drn = Interceptor Drones, Trc = Tractor Beams, Brg = Missile Barrage.
